name: speed-dial
title: Speed dial
description: A floating action that fans out three to five related actions on press, each labelled, reachable by keyboard and closing on Escape or an outside tap.
docs: The first action is the one nearest the trigger. Arrow keys move, Home and End jump, typing a letter finds an action, Escape closes. Like the floating action button it is fixed to the viewport; pass className="absolute" to keep it inside a container. direction="left" hangs each label above its button, so it needs short labels, and three actions take about 260px of width: on a phone use two or three.
